breakdown.description: Bernoulli equation used for compressible flow
breakdown.reason: The generated specification replaces the incompressible Bernoulli equation with the isentropic compressible flow relation P0/P = (1 + (γ−1)/2 · M^2)^(γ/(γ−1)), treating air as a compressible ideal gas. This matches the ground truth.

breakdown.description: Mach number is approximately 0.72, exceeding the incompressible limit of M < 0.3
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly computes the speed of sound and Mach number (M = v/a), which at 250 m/s and 300 K yields M ≈ 0.72. By computing M and using compressible isentropic relations instead of incompressible assumptions, the specification correctly handles the fact that M > 0.3, aligning with the ground truth.
